key_information_units.information: Q2 2026 revenue decreased to EUR 4.5 million from EUR 7.4 million in Q2 2025, with profit before tax of EUR -234 thousand versus EUR 1.0 million in Q2 2025, resulting in a net loss of EUR 618 thousand compared to a net profit of EUR 974 thousand in Q2 2025. The loss was impacted by EUR 384 thousand income tax expense on dividends and approximately EUR 90 thousand offering-related costs.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Consolidated statement of comprehensive income

key_information_units.information: For the first six months of 2026, revenue increased to EUR 11.4 million from EUR 9.3 million in the same period of 2025, with profit before tax of EUR 186 thousand versus EUR 296 thousand, and a net loss of EUR 198 thousand compared to a net profit of EUR 268 thousand.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Consolidated statement of comprehensive income

key_information_units.information: In Q2 2026, Liven signed 57 sales contracts totaling EUR 13.2 million in new sales revenue, with a presale portfolio of EUR 48.6 million across 171 contracts entering Q3 2026, of which EUR 39.8 million related to projects completing in 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section (including note that 3 contracts were in Berlin)

key_information_units.information: Liven handed over 12 homes in Q2 2026, down from 35 in Q2 2025, with a total of 26 homes and commercial units handed over in the first six months of 2026 compared to 41 in the same period of 2025.

As of 30 June 2026, Liven's balance sheet showed cash and cash equivalents of EUR 10.0 million, total assets of EUR 100.2 million, total liabilities of EUR 73.4 million, and equity of EUR 26.7 million, with construction loans amounting to EUR 16.6 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position; Note 6 for construction loans

key_information_units.information: Liven completed an initial public offering in April-May 2026, raising EUR 4.9 million through the issuance of new shares and listed its shares on the Nasdaq Tallinn Baltic Main List on 15 May 2026. Additionally, EUR 1.36 million in dividends was paid during the period.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Shareholders sections (including details of share price, number of shares, and dividend payment)

key_information_units.information: During Q2 2026, Liven expanded its Berlin portfolio by acquiring two development properties: Plantagenstraße 19 for EUR 1.7 million and Reichstraße 101 for EUR 1.2 million, planning nearly 20 residential units each with construction scheduled to start at the end of 2027 and the beginning of 2028, respectively.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section (including total project investment amounts over EUR 11 million and approximately EUR 8 million)

key_information_units.information: Following the reporting period in July 2026, Liven signed a contract to acquire development properties at Pärnu maantee 35, 37, and 41 in Tallinn for EUR 10 million, with plans for over 160 residential and commercial units.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Events after the reporting period section

key_information_units.information: Market dynamics in Q2 2026 showed a weekly sales ratio of nearly 3.1%, exceeding the long-term normal range of 1.5–2.0%, with Liven holding over 8% market share in Greater Tallinn during the first six months of 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Economic environment sections (including supporting factors such as recovering household purchasing power and unified tax-free minimum wage)

key_information_units.information: Liven's outlook for the remainder of 2026 indicates that nearly 90% of its EUR 59 million revenue target has been secured through realized revenue and contracts, with expectations for increasing revenue and net profit in H2 2026, aiming to exceed the 20% return on equity target.
